notes: DRAFT by Claude for organizers to edit. Recipes are element-symbol -> quantity. 'catalyst' is null or a catalyst id. Points are suggestions; game-balancer agent will tune.

catalysts.name: Enzyme
catalysts.flavor: Life's own shortcut lives in you.

compounds.name: Water
compounds.riddle: You drink me, swim in me, and I'm 60% of you. Two of the lightest, one of the breath.

compounds.name: Carbon Dioxide
compounds.riddle: I'm the fizz in your soda and the sigh you just exhaled. One of the pencil, two of the breath.

compounds.name: Carbon Monoxide
compounds.riddle: Silent, invisible, and the reason your house has an alarm. I'm my fizzy sibling, but missing a breath.

compounds.name: Methane
compounds.riddle: Cows make me, kitchens burn me. One dark atom surrounded by four tiny friends.

compounds.name: Table Salt
compounds.riddle: A metal that explodes in water + a poison gas = something you sprinkle on fries.

compounds.name: Hydrochloric Acid
compounds.riddle: Your stomach is full of me right now. One light, one green and poisonous.

compounds.name: Sodium Hydroxide
compounds.riddle: Soap-makers and drain-unblockers love me. One each of three: salt's metal, breath, and the lightest.

compounds.name: Quicklime
compounds.riddle: The bone-builder grabs a breath and becomes the stuff old builders used for mortar.

compounds.name: Chalk / Limestone
compounds.riddle: Your teacher wrote with me, cliffs are built of me. Bones, pencil, and three breaths.

compounds.name: Hydrogen Sulfide
compounds.riddle: I smell exactly like rotten eggs. I'm water's evil twin — swap the breath for the yellow one.

compounds.name: Sulfur Dioxide
compounds.riddle: Volcanoes burp me, acid rain starts with me. The yellow one, holding two breaths.

compounds.name: Nitrogen Dioxide
compounds.riddle: The brown haze over traffic jams. Air's most common atom, holding two breaths.

compounds.name: Laughing Gas
compounds.riddle: Dentists use me and you giggle. Two of the air's main atom, one breath.

compounds.name: Baking Soda
compounds.riddle: Volcano science projects and fluffy cakes need me. Four different atoms, and breath appears three times.

compounds.name: Calcium Chloride
compounds.riddle: Thrown on icy roads and packed into moisture absorbers. The bone-builder meets two greens.

compounds.name: Ammonia
compounds.riddle: I feed half the world as fertilizer and I smell like cleaning day. Air's atom with three tiny friends... but they won't hold hands unless squeezed.

compounds.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
compounds.riddle: I'm water with one breath too many — I bleach hair and fizz on cuts. Getting that extra breath needs a jolt.

compounds.name: Ozone
compounds.riddle: I'm the sky's sunscreen. Just breath, tripled — but only the sun's rays can stitch me together.

compounds.name: Glucose
compounds.riddle: Every leaf on campus is making me right now. Six, twelve, six — and the leaves' secret ingredient.

compounds.name: Table Sugar
compounds.riddle: Your chai needs two spoons of me. Twelve pencils, twenty-two tinies, eleven breaths. Sugarcane grew me in the sun.

compounds.name: Ethanol
compounds.riddle: Yeast makes me from sugar; hand sanitizer is mostly me. Two dark, six tiny, one breath — and something alive has to help.

compounds.name: Vinegar (Acetic Acid)
compounds.riddle: I'm the sour in your chips. Bacteria turn wine into me. Two, four, two.

compounds.name: Sulfuric Acid
compounds.riddle: The king of industrial chemicals; car batteries are full of me. Two tiny, one yellow, four breaths, forged in fire.

compounds.name: Nitric Acid
compounds.riddle: Rocket fuel and fertilizers start with me. One tiny, one from air, three breaths — burned into being.

compounds.name: Ethylene
compounds.riddle: I ripen bananas and I'm the start of every plastic bag. Crack oil with fire to find me: two and four.

compounds.name: Bleach
compounds.riddle: Salt plus a breath, but only if you zap salty water. Your white shirts thank me.

compounds.name: Urea
compounds.riddle: The first 'living' chemical ever made in a lab — and yes, it's in pee. Squeeze ammonia's cousins with a pencil and a breath.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×1, H ×4, N ×2, O ×1 — needs 🗜️ Pressure.

compounds.name: Caffeine
compounds.riddle: Exam week runs on me. Coffee plants build me: eight, ten, four, two.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×8, H ×10, N ×4, O ×2 — needs 🧬 Enzyme.

compounds.name: Aspirin
compounds.riddle: Headache? Willow bark had my ancestor. Nine, eight, four — and a sour push.

compounds.name: Banana Flavour (Isoamyl Acetate)
compounds.riddle: Fake banana candy tastes like me. Seven, fourteen, two — an acid has to bring us together.

compounds.name: Potassium Chloride
compounds.riddle: Low-sodium salt is secretly me. Banana's metal meets the green gas.

compounds.name: Saltpeter
compounds.riddle: The 'boom' part of fireworks. Banana metal, one from the air, three breaths.

compounds.name: Rust
compounds.riddle: Every old bicycle on campus wears me. Two of the blood metal, three breaths.

compounds.name: Copper Sulfate
compounds.riddle: Brilliant blue crystals from your school lab. The penny metal, the yellow one, four breaths.

compounds.name: Sand / Quartz
compounds.riddle: Dubai has a LOT of me. The chip-maker's element, holding two breaths.

compounds.name: Phosphoric Acid
compounds.riddle: The tang in cola. Three tiny, one matchstick-head, four breaths.

compounds.name: Sodium Fluoride
compounds.riddle: Your toothpaste's secret weapon. Salt's metal, but swap the green gas for the angriest element.

compounds.name: Epsom Salt
compounds.riddle: Sore muscles soak in me. The flash-bulb metal, the yellow one, four breaths.

compounds.name: Magnesium Oxide
compounds.riddle: Light me and I burn blinding white, leaving white ash behind. Flash metal + one breath + fire.

compounds.name: Alumina (Sapphire)
compounds.riddle: Add a pinch of impurity and I'm a sapphire. Two of the soda-can metal, three breaths, a furnace.

compounds.name: Fool's Gold (Pyrite)
compounds.riddle: I look like treasure but I'm not. Blood metal with two yellows, cooked deep underground.

compounds.name: Bone Mineral
compounds.riddle: You're holding your phone with me. Three bone-builders, two matchsticks, eight breaths — and your body's machinery.

compounds.name: Teflon (monomer)
compounds.riddle: Nothing sticks to me — not even eggs. Two pencils, four of the angriest element, squeezed hard.

compounds.name: Lithium Carbonate
compounds.riddle: Every phone battery starts its life as me. Two of the lightest metal, a pencil, three breaths.

compounds.name: Zinc Oxide
compounds.riddle: The white stuff on lifeguards' noses. The galvanizing metal, one breath.

compounds.name: Silver Nitrate
compounds.riddle: Election ink that won't wash off your finger. The mirror metal, one air, three breaths.

compounds.name: Potassium Iodide
compounds.riddle: Radiation-emergency pills. Banana metal meets the purple one.

compounds.name: Silver Chloride
compounds.riddle: Old film photographs were made of me — I darken when the world looks at me. Mirror metal + green gas + a flash.

compounds.name: Silver Iodide
compounds.riddle: The UAE sprays me into clouds to make it rain. Mirror metal + the purple one, packed tight.

compounds.name: Gold Chloride
compounds.riddle: Gold doesn't dissolve in anything... except the 'royal water'. One gold, three greens, and the strongest sour.

compounds.name: Lithium Iron Phosphate
compounds.riddle: Electric cars run on me. Lightest metal, blood metal, matchstick, four breaths — charged up.
compounds.lockedHint: Li ×1, Fe ×1, P ×1, O ×4 — needs ⚡ Electricity.

compounds.name: Zinc Chloride
compounds.riddle: Inside the cheap batteries in your TV remote. Galvanizing metal, two greens, a spark.

compounds.name: Heavy Water
compounds.riddle: I look exactly like water, but an ice cube of me sinks. Two heavy tinies, one breath, separated by a current.

compounds.name: Radiocarbon CO₂
compounds.riddle: Archaeologists date mummies by me. The ticking pencil, holding two breaths.

compounds.name: Heavy-Oxygen Water
compounds.riddle: Hospitals use me to make PET-scan tracers. Ordinary tinies, one heavy breath.

compounds.name: Uranium Hexafluoride
compounds.riddle: The most dangerous thing in this game. One fissile heavyweight, six of the angriest element, white-hot.

compounds.name: Chlorophyll a
compounds.riddle: Every green thing on Earth wears me. A huge ring with a flash-metal heart — fifty-five, seventy-two, one, four, five. Sunlight only.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×55, H ×72, Mg ×1, N ×4, O ×5 — needs ☀️ Light.

compounds.name: Heme
compounds.riddle: I'm why your blood is red. Chlorophyll's cousin, but my heart is the blood metal. Thirty-four, thirty-two, one, four, four.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×34, H ×32, Fe ×1, N ×4, O ×4 — needs 🧬 Enzyme.
